reviews.title: Comfy recovery suit
reviews.body: Got a medium size for our very slim 5 month old kitten to help stop her licking her sutures after her spay.She didnt enjoy having it put on but very quickly accepted wearing it and it doesnt seem to restrict her movement too much. Hasn't been able to get it off or get her legs stuck which is what I was worried about. Quality seems good and it is so much more comfortable for her than a cone. Bonus that she looks so cute in it!

reviews.title: Life saver for Spay surgery
reviews.body: I was not prepared for our little kitty’s surgery. We were told she should limit her exercise and try not to lick her stitches. Well that is all she wanted to do and about an hour or 2 after surgery she was climbing everything and running up and down the stairs like she didn’t just have surgery! She would lick her stitches non- stop so I immediately got on Amazon and ordered this set and got it on the second day. I wish I would have ordered it before surgery, but so glad I got it when I did. Shipping was fast. Our kitty is 5months old and around 5.5-6 lbs and roughly 12 inches long measuring the back and ordered the medium. I would say it fit pretty perfectly with plenty of wiggle room so would fit a bigger kitty weight wise just fine. It has some stretch and actually pretty good quality and the material is soft. It looks super cute and I am hoping with it on she will limit her exercise seeing as you can tell it’s something she has to get used to. She definitely walks a bit awkwardly, but not in a super uncomfortable way. I am very pleased with the set and serves our needs perfectly.

reviews.title: Great solution for an emergency fix
reviews.body: This is written immediately after ordering last night. I have a two year-old orange kitten I just got fixed yesterday. All night she has escaped her cone four times, the gabapentin does not work on her and instead makes her more energized, and I woke up this morning to find her coneless and just laying there as if she was proud of herself. Safe to say I've had zero sleep.On a whim, I ordered this last night for overnight delivery at 4 AM this morning because I needed a solution fast because of how many times she had escaped her cone. I went off of body weight, and I did not do length which is a risk I know I took. However these fit perfectly. Someone else that reviewed these had a 6 pound cat that was a year and a half to two years old, and they had a medium.Went right in, fits her without being too snug or being too loose, and she's much calmer in it. Even though she is not liking being in the space suit, she however is able to look around, eat, hide in her little cat house, because we have her in a large dog kennel due to the jungle cat she usually is going to the top of her cabinets and the window 20 feet up. We do not have a way to keep her from jumping to anything high because she always finds a way. We make sure to pay attention to her all the time because of that, and someone's at home with her at least all day.Not quite sure what kind of alien species I have for a cat, but this thing wiggles out of anything I've seen her get put in, gets to places no other cat can, and she's smarter than my blue heeler. I thought orange cat energy was a thing. She's very opposite.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 20 March 2026
reviews.author: Amanda

reviews.title: Great alternative to cone
reviews.body: Easy to put on and work really well. I won’t lie and say my cat loves these suits, because she definitely has moments where she tries to escape, but as long as the toggle is sufficiently tight (like a collar) she isn’t able to wiggle out of them. She much prefers the suit to the cone which she flung across the room the second she got home from the vets haha.The Velcro is nice and secure and it’s the right balance between being secure but not too tight on the wound area. The material stretches a little for movement and they are machine washable and dry quickly.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 27 April 2025
